review_metadata.case_selection_rule: Use exactly the deploy-assisted-intake-routing brief and PR132 interpretation read because PR136 gated to a second enriched brief test.
notes: PR137 repeats the PR135 enrichment shape on a different decision family.
No new interpretation read is created.
The cofounder case is not enriched in PR137.

enrichment_scope.scope: Add one plain-language interpretation section to the deploy-assisted-intake-routing rendered brief.
enrichment_scope.rule_source: PR135 enrichment rules, carried forward because PR136 did not require a patch.

fields_used.how_used: Rephrased the decision as deploy AI-assisted intake routing next month versus narrow it to a controlled operating test.
Included only as visible uncertainty that the starting point was already a narrow single-clinic pilot with a possibly heavy gate structure.
Used to clarify the action consequence: 48-hour backlog diagnostic, four must-pass gates, hard pause triggers, and narrower sales meaning.
Used as visible thresholds: bottleneck diagnostic, one-clinic scope, admin usability, compliance readiness, live-operating control, and pause after a credible misroute.
Used to show what the pilot must prove before it can carry broader operational or sales meaning.
Used only as a descriptive read: the process appears to have sharpened the move from an exhaustive control list toward an operable test.
Used to preserve that the enriched brief does not prove deployment, better advice, human validation, or agent authorization.

fields_excluded.reason: Kept evidence-only because the checked-in-safe read cannot prove the complete deployment option set.
Excluded because the read cannot safely distinguish fully rejected deployment paths from narrowed or gated paths.
Excluded from the main body because it could become unsupported criticism of the simplified four-gate plan.
Excluded because PR132 marks lost value as insufficient context.
Not selected for the tiny read and requires richer context or human review.
Patient, clinician, admin, compliance, support, and buyer obligations are only partially visible from safe summaries.
Requires raw conversation interpretation and is out of scope.

expected_reader_value.plain_language_read: The enriched section should help a reader see that the value is not just four gates instead of nine; it is an operable test tied to backlog cause, admin usability, compliance readiness, and hard pause triggers.
expected_reader_value.decision_story_value: It connects the action consequence to the conversation story without saying the simplified control surface is proven better.
expected_reader_value.what_a_busy_reader_should_get: A busy reader should understand why the feature should not be treated as the backlog solution or sold as autonomous intake automation.

risks.source_depth_risk: The enrichment still relies on checked-in-safe summaries and one provisional interpretation read; private clinical and compliance context may change the read.
risks.overclaim_risk: The enriched prose could imply four gates are better than nine unless the lost-controls risk remains visible.
risks.reader_confidence_risk: The cleaner story can make a provisional operating interpretation sound more settled than it is.
risks.quality_label_risk: Useful friction is included only as a descriptive read and must not become answer-quality scoring.

decision_gate.rationale: The second enriched brief is coherent, preserves uncertainty and non-claims, and does not reveal a blocking rule problem. The next step should compare the two enriched examples before any rules contract.

next_recommendation.recommended_next_pr: PR138 Enriched Brief Pattern Review v0
next_recommendation.recommended_action: Compare the launch-beta and intake-routing enriched briefs and decide whether enrichment rules are stable enough to formalize, need patching, should remain evidence-only, or should pause.
do_not_do_next: Do not implement a rules contract in PR137.
Do not enrich more cases in PR137.
Do not integrate enrichment into runtime.
Do not treat two enriched examples as product proof.
